records.name: Alexandra Park - London
records.location: Alexandra Park around Alexandra Palace, Muswell Hill/Wood Green, Haringey, London N22.
records.description: Splashd's archived card describes unnamed sections of Alexandra Palace's 196-acre park as a cruising lead, without a dated encounter. Alexandra Palace Trust confirms the park's identity; a Fireworks & Drone Festival on 7–8 November 2026 temporarily restricts park and road access 6–9 November.
records.original_source_description: This location has 196 acres of parkland. While there's quite a stretch of potential areas to cruise, the most likely place to find action is in the lower park. The bushes and trees offer great cover, and it would be a clear signal to other cruisers.

records.name: Parkland Walk
records.location: Parkland Walk, a disused railway green corridor between Finsbury Park and Highgate/ Alexandra Palace, Islington–Haringey, north London.
records.description: Splashd and CruisingGays independently name Parkland Walk, but CruisingGays' historical account shows a 2011 update rather than recent activity. Islington Council confirms this is a 4.5-mile nature-reserve route open to walkers and cyclists; there is no identified specific public cruising facility.
records.original_source_description: An old Victorian railway line that has been left to grow as a nature reserve. Lots of nooks and crannies in the bushes where you can have fun. Cruisiest just after the 1st bridge, across Upper Tollington Park, there are bushes on either side you can use.

records.name: West Hampstead Cemetery
records.location: Hampstead Cemetery, Fortune Green Road, West Hampstead, Camden, London NW6 1DR; Splashd calls it West Hampstead Cemetery.
records.description: Splashd describes this as a cemetery cruising lead, with dusk gate locking. Camden's public directory identifies the physical cemetery as Hampstead Cemetery and reports an official operator. A 2026 pilot of extended evening access ended 25 October; no recent firsthand cruising visit is verified.
records.original_source_description: Ideal place for cruising up until sunset - nice and quiet and lots of places to hide and have fun. All types of guys come here. Watch out for gardeners and dog walkers. Warden comes around at dusk to lock the gates.

records.name: Wormwood Scrubs Park
records.location: Wormwood Scrubs public open space north of Wormwood Scrubs prison, Shepherds Bush/White City, Hammersmith and Fulham, west London W12.
records.description: Splashd and an old CruisingGays directory record the park as a cruising lead. Local authority documents separately verify the large public open space. Neither archive provides a dated firsthand encounter since November 2025; broad grounds cannot support precise crowded-area directions.
records.original_source_description: A large open space just north of the notorious Wormwood Scrubs prison. There is a car park just opposite the Pavilion public house (24a North Pole Road) and it's just a 5-minute walk north of here to reach the northeastern corner of the park.
